meta_description: Paint Pallet is your local interior decorator in Nottingham. Professional painting and decorating services for homes and businesses. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior decorating. From feature walls to full room makeovers, we deliver results that last.
services_subhead: From detailed wall finishes to comprehensive room transformations, we handle every aspect of interior decoration with precision and care.

services.title: Feature Wall Painting
services.desc: Create a stunning focal point with our expert feature wall design and application. We help you choose the perfect colour and finish for maximum impact.

services.title: Full Interior Redecoration
services.desc: Complete room refreshes including walls, woodwork, and ceilings. We protect your furniture and furnishings, leaving your space immaculate when finished.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation and removal using premium adhesives and techniques. We handle tricky corners, ceiling joins, and archways with precision.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Work
services.desc: Thorough sanding, filling, and preparation ensures a flawless finish. We never skip this step — it's why our work lasts years longer than the rest.

services.title: Faux Finishes & Special Effects
services.desc: Add texture and character with techniques like sponging, stippling, and marbling. Ideal for creating unique interiors that reflect your personality.

services.title: Commercial Space Decoration
services.desc: Office repaints, retail fit-outs, and hospitality interiors completed to schedule. We work around your business hours and minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: I paint walls the way I'd want my own home done.
about_para_1: Paint Pallet started in 2012 when I got tired of seeing sloppy decorating work in Nottingham homes. I trained as a professional decorator, invested in quality tools and paints, and built a reputation one satisfied customer at a time. Today we've completed over 850 interior projects across the city and beyond.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is genuine attention to detail. We prep every surface properly, use premium paints matched to your exact vision, and always leave the site spotless. Our customers come back because they know the job will be done right, on time, and at a fair price.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge. The prep work was thorough, no mess left behind, and the feature wall looks exactly how we'd imagined. Paul was professional and chatty — would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Had our entire downstairs redecorated. The team finished on schedule despite a few tricky corners. The quality of finish is miles above what we'd had before. Fair pricing too.
reviews.author: Michael H.

reviews.text: Really impressive attention to detail. They sorted our old wallpaper removal, filled all the cracks properly, and the new paint looks immaculate. Would use again in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: Sarah L.
